EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 1048 August 8, 1985
Subject Matter : Rehabilitation program to facilitate the reintegration to society of disidents who return to the
folds of the law to include their mass supporters and providing for a Presidential Committee for the
implementation thereof.
Date of Effectivity : August 8, 1985
